name: KDE Connect helper
description: Adds a KDE Connect status button, device actions, guided installation, and portable user autostart controls.
author: flathead
permissions: Reads KDE Connect device, connection, battery, and plugin data over the session D-Bus
Discovers trusted KDE Connect, qdbus, package manager, pkexec, and systemctl executables
Reads /etc/os-release to propose a distribution-specific KDE Connect installation method
Launches an official KDE Connect interface or the KDE Connect daemon after explicit user action
Sends ping and ring requests to the selected paired device after explicit user action
Shares a user-selected file or entered text with the selected paired device after confirmation
May invoke pkexec with pacman or dnf to install a fixed KDE Connect package after two confirmations
Reads and manages marked user-level systemd or XDG autostart files without root access
Stores mod settings and the preferred KDE Connect device identifier
